title: Position: Medical AI Neglects Real Treatment Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2608.14598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical AI has rapidly improved its ability to perform diagnostic and prognostic tasks that lead to treatment decisions. But understanding of treatment itself is still inadequately trained and evaluated, using human opinions and syntheses (especially texts such as biomedical publications and clinical practice guidelines) rather than actual underlying data on treatment outcomes. This neglect seriously limits the potential of medical AI, and is already causing deficiencies in both frontier models and major benchmarks, as argued in this position paper. Real treatment outcomes, drawn from sources such as observational databases and randomized experiments, should be substantially incorporated into both training and evaluation. Improving these outcomes should be reemphasized as the downstream goal of all medical AI.

translated_title: 立场：医疗AI忽视了真实的治疗结果
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14598v1 公告类型：新  摘要：医疗AI在执行导致治疗决策的诊断和预后任务方面的能力已迅速提升。然而，对治疗本身的理解在训练和评估上仍不充分，主要依赖人类意见和综合资料（尤其是生物医学出版物和临床实践指南等文本），而非基于治疗结果的实际底层数据。本立场论文指出，这种忽视严重限制了医疗AI的潜力，并已在尖端模型和主要基准测试中造成缺陷。来自观察性数据库和随机实验等来源的真实治疗结果应大幅纳入训练和评估中。改善这些结果应被重新强调为所有医疗AI的下游目标。
tldr: 医疗AI因忽视基于真实数据的治疗结果评估，而仅依赖人类意见和文本资料，限制了其潜力，本文主张将真实治疗结果纳入训练与评估以改善疗效。
en_tdlr: Medical AI neglects real treatment outcomes by relying on human opinions and texts, limiting its potential; this paper advocates incorporating actual outcome data into training and evaluation to improve efficacy.
